# Quantum Supremacy Paper Review (Arute et al., 2019)

Review of the experimental demonstration of quantum computational supremacy using a programmable superconducting processor.

## Sycamore Architecture

The 53-qubit Sycamore chip executed random circuit sampling in 200 seconds, a task estimated to require classical supercomputers days or weeks.

The underlying operational mechanism relies on maintaining high-fidelity two-qubit gate operations preserving `QUANTUM-ENTANGLEMENT` across the 2D lattice.
